name: patesystem-e2e
description: Suite E2E/API para PateSystem con Playwright + TypeScript + Cucumber

scripts.report: node -e "const {execSync}=require('child_process'); const cmd=process.platform==='win32'?'start reports/cucumber-report.html':'open reports/cucumber-report.html'; try { execSync(cmd, {stdio:'inherit'}); } catch(e) {}"
scripts.ui: echo 'Cucumber no tiene modo UI interactivo. Usar: npm run test:ui' && exit 1
